about: play.zenithschool.ai (KRMU Ideas 4.0 stall, 27-28 Oct 2026) on AWS Lightsail in Mumbai, the Field App way. Names and sizes only, no secrets. Used by ops/aws/lightsail.mjs and ops/set-claude-key.mjs. Every name must start with play- (the script refuses anything else).

web.about: The one Node app (hub, 5 experiences, Claude proxy, analytics, SSE live bus to the TVs). Scale stays 1: the live bus and the leaderboard live in memory, so one node by design.

reel.about: Squad Reel worker (Node + ffmpeg), built from reel-worker/Dockerfile (TASK-04 owns it). Scale 1: the job queue is in memory and files live on the container disk for at most 48h.

bucket.name: play-data
bucket.about: Private. Only the anonymous counters snapshot (counts per experience per day). No photos, audio, video or names, ever.
